rules: No network, model, search, credential, source fetch, database, or cloud operation is permitted in P4-A.
Research inputs must be explicitly synthetic and must not contain real publisher content.
The controller recomputes claim verification from evidence links; upstream verification labels are not trusted.
A candidate may use only claims and evidence owned by its event.
Repeated event ids keep issuer, instrument identity, entity set, and lifecycle history stable; only explicit unknown-to-known enrichment is allowed and earliest first-seen time wins.
Primary-document support is derived from checked evidence role and publisher identity; an upstream boolean is not authoritative.
A checked coverage cell must include every required market language.
Follow-up limits are enforced per event and stop at sufficient evidence, no new independent information, a hard budget, required-source unavailability, or technical failure.
Research-role query counts are validated as non-negative integers at the controller trust boundary.
Technical failure clears publishable artifacts but does not erase accepted budget consumption.
Output must pass the P0 intelligence-result schema and cross-field invariants.
